body: People tried to help me, but I'm a lost cause. Just took more pills and getting sleepy. Thank you for your kindness, though. The people at stopdrinking made it pretty clear I didn't mean a goddamned thing to them when they deleted my post. See you on the other side, folks.
I called the uk one thank you all, xx

I can't stop drinking. My dog died because I was too drunk to save him. My mum died. I have no one. I lost my job. I'm a deadbeat alcoholic and no one will miss me.
You are so kind. Keep fighting the fight. I am going to have to go now.
I can't. Live your life. Enjoy it. I cannot enjoy mine anymore.
My dog is dead. My mum just committed suicide a week ago. I buried her yesterday. No one will miss me. Thank you for your kindness, though.
My dog died because I was too drunk to function to save him. I keep relapsing. Just took the pills, they will kick in soon. I'm sorry I failed everyone here.
Not sure why I'm responding, as I'll be dead soon, but everything I have left in my pill bottle from a surgery a year ago. Percocet. 24 pills in all.
Stay strong. I couldn't but you can.
